label: D2 after choosing a2 and landing in S2 (common), following a rewarded trial, in the first ~50 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO) and almost only when the GO choice was a2 (in_action == 2); 98.7% of mass is when the reached state is S2 (a2 common), with weak activation on a2->S1 rare. It is also strongly gated by episode time: nearly all activation is in episode trials 3-49 and essentially none after trial 50, with magnitude decaying steadily over the episode (e.g. 0.86, 0.84, 0.80, 0.78 on successive a2->S2 trials). Strongest when the previous trial was rewarded; unrewarded previous trials give weaker or no activation. Correlates with high model value (value > 8.1 holds 97% of mass). All variables are observed at D2 (this trial choice and state are shown at D2; prev_reward was seen at D1). Base (D2 & a2 & S2 & ep_trial<50) has recall 0.94 but precision 0.54; adding prev_reward == 1 raises precision to 0.76 at recall 0.84 (dev F1 0.80). Does not fire on a1 choices, on any D1/GO step, or late in the episode.
